system.description:
Kelpie Traits

Characters with the kelpie heritage share a variety of traits with one another.

Fey Lineage. You are filled with the bitter chill of the faerie realms that exist in eternal twilight. Your creature type is fey in addition to humanoid.

Age. Kelpies age and mature at a similar rate to humans, though they live slightly longer, reaching ages of 200 years.

Size. In their humanoid form, kelpies typically range between 5–6 feet tall and weigh no more than 200 lbs. Your size is Medium.

Speed. In humanoid form, your base Speed is 30 feet. You also have a Swim speed of 30 feet.

Alarming Allure. You gain proficiency with Persuasion, or an expertise die if you were already proficient.

Horse Form. As a bonus action, you may shapeshift into your choice of a @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-monsters.Actor.scecq7mxrzd425pz]{Pony} or a @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-monsters.Actor.b8ea8murgijmefmu]{Draft Horse}. You make this choice at character creation and it cannot be changed at a later time.

While in your horse form, you retain your hit points, your mental statistics, and your @UUID[Compendium.out-of-the-wilds.features.Item.5MRgPI8Yo3TGCES7]{Alarming Allure} trait from your kelpie heritage. You may still use any features you have that grant you bonuses to your AC that do not require the use of armor (such as an adept’s @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.zh0pv154q6abroh6]{Agile Defense}), but otherwise you assume the statistics of your chosen horse form. Any equipment you are wearing or wielding merges into your new form and has no effect until you leave your horse form. You may remain in your horse form indefinitely, though if you are reduced to 0 hit points you revert back to your humanoid form. You may also dismiss your horse form as a bonus action.

As a horse you cannot speak, but you gain an expertise die to Persuasion checks made to encourage others to follow you. If you are near a deep body of water (such as a lake or ocean), you make your check at advantage.

If you selected draft horse, a Medium-sized creature or smaller (Small-sized or smaller if you selected pony) may sit astride you as a normal horse, though they cannot activate any combat maneuvers or class features that make use of a mount while on your back.

If you gain the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.3jdfihvtbyhbv9ez]{Wild Shape} feature, this feature does not gain any of its benefits.

Kelpie Gifts

In addition to the traits found in your kelpie heritage, select one of the following gifts.

Chilling Demeanor

You learn the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.z1ecx6kweubsvogl]{Otherworldliness} cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you may cast the spell @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.i4ejucvglhqpfm57]{Fog Cloud} once per long rest. At 5th level, you may cast @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.36x8lw8mhfigm7ti]{Enthrall} once per long rest. You do not require material components for these spells, and your spellcasting modifier is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, whichever is highest.

Harrowing Hybrid

You retain a humanoid body and are capable of speech, but you gain the facial features of your @UUID[Compendium.out-of-the-wilds.features.Item.Qtnb2A7Jam5E4k7s]{Horse Form}. While in your hybrid form, you gain proficiency with Intimidation, or an expertise die if you were already proficient. When you successfully intimidate a creature, you have advantage on Intimidation checks against that creature for the next 24 hours.

Predatory Nature

While in your horse form, you gain a bite attack that on a hit deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage.

Additionally, your senses are heightened when you can smell blood in the air. You have advantage on Survival checks made to track a wounded or bloodied creature.

Kelpie Paragon

When you reach 10th level, you become a better kelpie and gain one paragon gift from the following list.

Mighty Hooves

While in your horse form, your attacks with your hooves count as magical for the purposes of overcoming damage resistances.

Additionally, while in @UUID[Compendium.out-of-the-wilds.features.Item.Qtnb2A7Jam5E4k7s]{Horse Form}, you gain the following ability:

Trample. You trample enemies in your path. As a bonus action, you may move up to half your movement speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Creatures in your path that are at least one size category smaller than you just make a Dexterity saving throw versus your maneuver DC. On a failure, a creature takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked [[/condition id=prone]].

You may use your Trample ability once per long rest.

Robes of Winter

You learn the spell @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.lnbcwy44k19g4bbu]{Fire Shield} and always cast it with the chill shield option.

Once per long rest you may cast this spell without material components and without expending a spell slot.

Wretched Whinny

All creatures of your choosing within 30 feet of you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw versus your passive Intimidation or become frightened of you until the start of your next turn. You may use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
